# tagesschau.de

> > Germany's leading public broadcast news service providing fact-checked journalism, breaking news, and in-depth analysis on national and international affairs.

tagesschau.de is the online presence of ARD's flagship news program, offering comprehensive coverage of German and world news with a strong emphasis on fact-checking through its ARD-faktenfinder initiative. The site also maintains technical infrastructure including deployment management tools for content delivery.

## Key Topics

- ARD-faktenfinder
- Fact-checking and verification
- Disinformation detection
- Iran conflict coverage
- Israel news
- Trump fact-checks
- German politics (Schleswig-Holstein)
- O-Neko Catnip deployment tools
- Sophora CMS integration
- DevOps infrastructure
- Breaking news coverage
- International affairs
- Public broadcasting journalism

## Fact-Checking & Verification

- [faktenfinder - Fakten-Checks und Hintergründe](https://faktenfinder.tagesschau.de/): ARD-faktenfinder fact-checking section covering Iran, Israel & disinformation

## Optional

- [O-Neko Catnip - Sophora Integration](https://featureus1029frontendschriftartinmul.komponenten.b.tagesschau.de/): O-Neko Catnip deployment management tool for Sophora integration
- [O-Neko Catnip - DevOps Proxy](https://featureus1353frontendtextlinkbeibild.komponenten.b.tagesschau.de/): O-Neko Catnip DevOps deployment proxy with auto-start features
- [O-Neko Catnip - Deployment Trigger](https://featureus1317frontendverbessertearia.komponenten.b.tagesschau.de/): O-Neko Catnip URL-based deployment trigger management system
